cityQuote: “Glasgow is a magnificent city,” said McAlpin. “Why do we hardly ever notice that?” “Because nobody imagines living here,” said Thaw.
cityQuoteAttribution: Alasdair Gray, novelist and artist, Lanark (1981)

quoteAlternatives.quote: Glasgow is a magnificent city. Why do we hardly ever notice that? Because nobody imagines living here.
quoteAlternatives.attribution: Alasdair Gray, novelist and artist, Lanark (1981)
quoteAlternatives.note: Same passage with the speaker tags removed. It is dialogue between two characters, so this form reads as Gray's own line, which it is only loosely.

quoteAlternatives.attribution: City of Glasgow motto, shortened from a sermon by St Mungo
quoteAlternatives.note: The city motto, on the coat of arms. The full version is “Lord, let Glasgow flourish by the preaching of thy word.” Short, but not a writer's observation.
